base.name: AI Tool: uv
base.description: Install or repair uv inside Ubuntu through the official standalone installer, with a source reachability and download speed check before install.

recipe.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates; fi
URL=https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh
TMP=/workspace/.kf/downloads/uv-install.sh
mkdir -p /workspace/.kf/downloads /workspace/.kf/bin
METRICS=$(curl -L --fail --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 45 -w '%{http_code} %{speed_download} %{size_download}' -o $TMP $URL)
set -- $METRICS
HTTP=$1
SPEED=${2%.*}
BYTES=${3%.*}
echo [kite] uv source http=$HTTP speed=${SPEED}Bps bytes=$BYTES
test $BYTES -gt 1000
test $SPEED -ge 1024
UV_INSTALL_DIR=/workspace/.kf/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh $TMP
export PATH=/workspace/.kf/bin:$PATH
uv --version
echo kite_uv_install_ok
